March 2026

Abserny v1.0 Released for Android

First Public Release

Abserny v1.0 is now publicly available as an Android APK on GitHub Releases. This is the first complete, stable release of the app, representing the full vision of a gesture-driven, voice-first AI assistant for visually impaired users.

↓
Download abserny-v1.0.apk — Enable "Install from unknown sources" on your Android device before installing.

What's in v1.0

Gesture control

Five gestures cover the entire application — double tap to scan, long press to repeat, swipe left/right to change mode, triple tap for settings. No buttons, no visual interface, no screen interaction required at any point.

AI vision, online and offline

Online, frames are sent to Gemini 2.0 Flash Lite with mode-specific prompts tuned per language. Offline, ML Kit on-device image labeling and OCR activate silently and automatically with a 380 ms median latency and 0% failure rate across 50 test trials.

Four detection modes

Scene (environmental awareness), Object (close-range identification), Read (OCR text recognition), and People (social navigation). Each has its own Arabic and English Gemini prompts tuned for the specific task.

Bilingual, Arabic and English

Complete support at every layer: TTS voices (ar-SA rate 0.82, en-US rate 0.88), per-language Gemini prompts, UI announcements, and RTL layout in Arabic mode. Language selected during a spoken onboarding — no reading required.

Voice-first onboarding

First launch speaks a language picker, then walks through each gesture interactively. The user must perform each gesture to advance. Zero sighted assistance required from the very first second of use.

Spoken Settings menu

Triple tap in READY state opens a fully spoken settings overlay. Navigate by swipe, confirm by double tap, close by long press. Change language or replay the tutorial at any time.

FSM architecture

A deterministic finite state machine (BOOT, READY, SCANNING, SPEAKING, ERROR) governs all interaction, making race conditions and simultaneous scans structurally impossible.

Known limitations in v1.0

  • Android only — iOS pending Apple Developer Program enrollment
  • AbserneyVision custom model at 37% validation accuracy, dataset expansion ongoing
  • Gemini free tier rate limits may cause occasional API errors (auto-recovered)
  • Requires Android 8.0 (API 26) or higher

What's next

  • AbserneyVision model accuracy improvements toward 80%+
  • iOS build once Apple Developer enrollment is complete
  • ASR project — optional voice trigger mode

Full technical documentation is available at the mobile app docs.
